methodology.purpose: Third-party publisher-level political/media-bias context. These ratings never alter Atlas proposition-level evidence grade.
methodology.provider_separation: Provider methodologies are not normalized, averaged, or converted into a universal Atlas bias score.
methodology.display_rule: Always identify the provider with its native rating. If no verified third-party rating is stored, display NO INDEPENDENT POLITICAL-BIAS RATING LOCATED. For official/technical sources where political-bias scoring is not meaningful, display NOT APPLICABLE.
methodology.ground_news_compatibility: Existing data/ground-news-outlet-metadata.json remains authoritative for Ground News fields. This file adds alternative-provider records and multi-provider display context without rewriting Ground News metadata.

ALLSIDES.native_scale: LEFT / LEAN LEFT / CENTER / LEAN RIGHT / RIGHT
ALLSIDES.rating_scope_note: Publisher-level media-bias context; rating scope is provider-defined and must be shown with the provider name.

AD_FONTES.native_scale: Numeric bias score on -42 to +42 plus provider category; separate 0-64 reliability score
AD_FONTES.rating_scope_note: Publisher-level bias and reliability context. Ad Fontes reliability is not an Atlas evidence grade.

ratings.label: MIDDLE
ratings.notes: Use as the alternative-provider example when Ground News has no rating. AllSides currently lists AFP as Not Rated; do not treat that as a Center rating.

ratings.label: CENTER
ratings.notes: Additional provider context only. Existing Ground News metadata remains independently displayed and is not replaced.

ratings.label: CENTER
ratings.notes: AllSides states this rating applies to BBC online written news, not television/radio content.

negative_control.rule: A provider's NOT_RATED result must never render as CENTER and does not override a verified rating from a different named provider.
